Ownership hypothetical forced a correction: Colossus Hammer is the wrong cut (winConditions[0] anchor, flagship Sigarda's Aid synergy 87.6%/70.0%, {1} for +10/+10 beats Steel's board-dependent buff until 6 Equipment); least-bad cut would be Buster Sword, and even that swap is metrics-neutral. guideContent.strategyOverview: Suit up Captain America and win two ways with the same gear. Catch attaches an Equipment free at the start of each of your combats, and Throw ({3}, reduced to {1} by Zirda) unattaches one to deal its mana value in damage split among up to three targets — the Equipment stays on the battlefield, so Catch re-attaches it next turn for a repeatable damage engine. The primary kill is 21 commander damage through Excalibur, Colossus Hammer, and Mjölnir's damage doubling, with Embercleave flashing in after blocks; Super State upgrades a single connect into a table kill by mirroring Cap's combat damage to every other opponent, and Mjölnir-doubled Throw burn stays the backup plan. A dense attach-cheat suite beyond Catch keeps equip costs honest, Stonehewer Giant and Cloud fetch the right tool on demand, Sunforger packages the deck's red-white instants, and Sword of Feast and Famine plus Aggravated Assault closes with infinite combats when the table demands it.

deckCategories.name: Vibranium Payloads
deckCategories.description: High-mana-value Throw fuel: each of these deals its full mana value when thrown and comes back via Catch. Excalibur throws for 12 and usually casts for far less thanks to its historic cost reduction; Kaldra Compleat brings a living-weapon body; Embercleave flashes in after blocks and throws for 6. Super State isn't gear at all — the {7} suit rebases Cap at 9/9 and mirrors his combat damage to the whole table.

deckCategories.name: Standard-Issue Kit
deckCategories.description: Cheap combat gear for the voltron line: Colossus Hammer plus a free attach is the classic one-shot, Mjölnir doubles all of Cap's damage (equip {1} — he is worthy), and Captain America's own Shield gives him +0/+8 and indestructibility to hide behind. Shadowspear adds trample and lifelink for one mana — Hammer-Cap punches through chump blocks — and its {1} activation strips opponents' hexproof and indestructible for the turn.

deckCategories.name: Rapid Deployment
deckCategories.description: Attach-cheat density beyond Catch: flash attaches, free equips, mass re-attach at combat, and cost reduction. Zirda cuts Throw from {3} to {1}; Halvar grants every equipped or enchanted creature double strike and moves a piece of gear free at each combat; Leonin Shikari makes every equip instant-speed (near-{0} under Puresteel's metalcraft); Codsworth adds ward {2} on Cap, restricted {W}{W} for gear casts, and a sorcery-speed free attach.
cards: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

deckCategories.name: Quartermaster Corps
deckCategories.description: Equipment tutors keep the draw consistent: Stoneforge cheats the fetched piece into play, Stonehewer Giant fetches any Equipment onto the battlefield attached at instant speed, Cloud tutors to hand on entry, and Armored Skyhunter digs six deep and attaches for free on attack.

deckCategories.name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Intel
deckCategories.description: Equipment-native card advantage. Sram and Puresteel cantrip every Equipment cast; Akiri draws whenever an equipped creature attacks a player, and Jhoira draws on every historic cast — most of the deck qualifies. Emry mills four on entry and taps to re-buy any artifact from the graveyard, with affinity often making her a one-mana body.

deckCategories.name: Bodyguard Detail
deckCategories.description: Keeping one creature alive is the whole game plan: a free counterspell and a one-mana redirect while 4-power Cap is deployed, Clever Concealment phasing the whole suit out of a board wipe with everything still attached, and Unfinished Business rebuilding Cap's armory from the graveyard — a creature plus up to two attachments, attached — when protection fails anyway.

deckCategories.name: Counteroffensive
deckCategories.description: Interaction that leans on the deck's shape: Dispatch's metalcraft is trivially on, Stubborn Denial is a one-mana Negate while 4-power Cap is deployed, Counterspell and Mana Drain answer anything — Drain's rebate re-deploys gear on the next main phase — Single Combat is an asymmetric wrath that leaves the suited commander standing alone, and Blasphemous Act resets creature boards for as little as {R} while every Equipment survives.

deckCategories.name: Supply Lines
deckCategories.description: Artifact-lean acceleration. Dalakos taps for {C}{C} that pays equip costs (they are Equipment abilities) — though not Throw, which is Cap's own ability — and gives the equipped commander flying and haste.

synergies.title: The hammer drop
synergies.description: Sigarda's Aid gives Equipment flash and attaches them free on entry — Colossus Hammer's equip {8} never gets paid. A 14/14 Captain America is a two-hit commander kill.

sources.name: EDHREC — Captain America, First Avenger
sources.detail: Sigarda's Aid 87.6% inclusion, +0.82 synergy; Colossus Hammer 70.0%

synergies.title: Worthy of the hammer
synergies.description: Cap is legendary, non-Villain, and red-white — worthy, so Mjölnir equips for {1} and doubles all damage he deals. Excalibur in combat is 28 commander damage in one connect (4+10 power, doubled); thrown, it is 24 damage split up to three ways.

synergies.title: Infinite combat steps
synergies.description: Combat damage from the equipped commander untaps all lands; with five lands producing {3}{R}{R}, Aggravated Assault grants another combat every time — arbitrarily many attacks. Flagged as this deck's single compact combo line.

sources.name: Commander Spellbook
sources.detail: Classic two-card combat loop; verified against the drafted 99

synergies.title: Deathtouch fastball
synergies.description: With Basilisk Collar attached, every Throw split is deathtouch-and-lifelink removal — a three-way split kills three creatures regardless of size. Chandra's Ignition with Collar attached is a one-sided wipe: deathtouch kills every other creature it touches and lifelink banks Cap's power times the bodies hit.

sources.name: DEC-422 Throw-engine analysis; Ignition pairing re-derived in DEC-421 tuning round v1.2

synergies.title: Double strike doctrine
cards: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms
synergies.description: Halvar's static grant gives every equipped or enchanted creature you control double strike — a Hammer-equipped Cap connects for 28 commander damage in one swing, past the 21 threshold with no other help. Halvar's beginning-of-combat trigger also moves the Hammer (or any Aura or Equipment) to the open attacker each turn, so equip {8} never gets paid twice.

sources.name: EDHREC — Captain America, First Avenger
sources.detail: Halvar 31.6% inclusion on Cap's page; kill math clause-checked via Scryfall oracle in DEC-430

synergies.title: Field repair loop
synergies.description: Akiri unattaches an Equipment for {W} to make Cap indestructible in a pinch, and Catch re-attaches it free next combat; Hammer of Nazahn makes the same protection permanent while auto-attaching every Equipment that enters.

sources.name: EDHREC — Captain America, First Avenger
sources.detail: Akiri 56.7%, Hammer of Nazahn 61.3% inclusion

synergies.title: One swing, whole table
synergies.description: Super State rebases Cap at 9/9 with flying, first strike, trample, and haste; Mjölnir doubles his combat damage to 18, and the State's mirror trigger — damage dealt by Cap himself — is doubled again: 18 to the defender, 36 to each other opponent, one swing. With Colossus Hammer on board instead it is 19/19 for 38/76, though the Hammer's "loses flying" clause fights Super State's flying grant on attach timestamps, so trample carries that line, not evasion.

sources.name: DEC-421 tuning round v1.2 — kill-line math, clause-checked via Scryfall oracle text

synergies.title: Midnight requisition
synergies.description: Stonehewer's {1}{W}, tap (cheaper with Zirda) fetches any Equipment onto the battlefield already attached, at instant speed — the only effect in the deck that bypasses Kaldra Compleat's {7} cast entirely, and it fetches Mithril Coat or Colossus Hammer mid-combat.

sources.name: DEC-421 tuning round v1.2 — attach-cheat analysis

synergies.title: Sunforger package
synergies.description: Unattach Sunforger to fetch and free-cast any of six red/white instants (Swords, Dispatch, Abrade, Generous Gift, Boros Charm, Bolt Bend) — then Catch re-attaches Sunforger for free next turn instead of paying equip {3}.

winConditions.title: 21 commander damage
winConditions.description: Free-attached kill pieces turn the 4/4 commander into a one- or two-hit clock: Colossus Hammer makes him 14/14, Excalibur 14/4 with vigilance, and Mjölnir doubles either into a single-connect kill. Embercleave flashes in after blocks — 15/15 double strike trample with the Hammer is 30 commander damage in one swing — and Super-Soldier Serum mass-attaches the whole armory when he attacks.

winConditions.title: Super State table mirror
winConditions.description: Super State's 9/9 rebase plus its mirror trigger turns one connect into a table kill: Mjölnir doubles the combat damage to 18 and the mirrored damage to 36 at each other opponent. Colossus Hammer pushes the same line to 38/76 (trample carries it — the Hammer's "loses flying" clause can cancel the State's flying grant depending on attach order).

winConditions.title: Amplified Throw burn
winConditions.description: Throw converts gear into direct damage: Excalibur alone is 12 split three ways, 24 with Mjölnir attached. Chandra's Ignition off a suited-up Cap doubles as a board wipe that hits every opponent for his power — and it only scales up as the suit grows.

winConditions.title: Infinite combats
winConditions.description: Sword of Feast and Famine untaps all lands on connect; Aggravated Assault converts {3}{R}{R} into an extra combat — every attack pays for the next. The deck's only infinite line, board-flagged per the DEC-422 combo watch.
